verdict.rationale: Data-use and training opt-out is a fair privacy question for an AI gateway that proxies and logs LLM traffic, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no statement that Portkey prevents customer data from being used for model training, and no training opt-out control. Routing to privately hosted models and guardrails against sensitive-data leaks are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
